bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; requiring rule amendments on boat storage structures in public waters.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. BOAT STORAGE STRUCTURES; REQUIRED RULEMAKING.

The commissioner of natural resources must amend Minnesota Rules, chapter 6115, to:

(1) amend the definition of "watercraft canopy" to replace the term "fabric covered roof" with "fabric- or metal-covered roof"; and

(2) allow placement of a boat storage structure on public waters without a permit if the boat storage structure has a fabric- or metal-covered roof and is otherwise not prohibited under Minnesota Rules, part 6115.0210, subpart 3.
additions: The commissioner of natural resources must amend Minnesota Rules, chapter 6115, to:

(2) allow placement of a boat storage structure on public waters without a permit if the boat storage structure has a fabric- or metal-covered roof and is otherwise not prohibited under Minnesota Rules, part 6115.0210, subpart 3.
